name: model-advisor
description: Reads each prompt you send and says which model and effort would do it, so you stop paying Opus at xhigh for a commit message.

mode.title: Model advisor
mode.description: suggest: show what would do, change nothing. auto: also send a prompt on the cheaper setup when the advisor is sure and the switch pays for itself. off: say nothing.

log.title: Prompt log
log.description: on: keep your newest 400 prompts, how each was read and how its turn went, in this plugin's store on your machine, for /advise log and calibration. Secrets are masked; nothing is sent anywhere. off (the default): keep nothing new.
